events.issue: BrowserContext.new_page viewport argument invalid in test
events.resolution: Create page then set viewport, real UI replayed

events.issue: Browser downloaded older ready export while new request was pending
events.resolution: Wait for request acknowledgement and refreshed row before download, real CSV contains fixture

events.issue: Two insufficient text contrasts detected by axe
events.resolution: Darker secondary text, replay reports zero violations and zero incomplete

events.issue: BusyBox sha256sum does not implement ignore-missing
events.resolution: Select exact Terraform checksum entry before verification, checksum passed

events.issue: Nested file mount under readonly secret directory could not be created
events.resolution: Dedicated TLS mount path, private CA/admin credentials absent from app runtime

events.issue: Parallel restart of broker and network-sharing TLS sidecar can race
events.resolution: Restart broker first, then start TLS sidecar/API/worker; pending SQL job recovered without volume deletion
